newsitem.title: FRANCE: Arthuis says deficit elimination is the objective.
newsitem.headline: Arthuis says deficit elimination is the objective.

text.p: French finance minister Jean Arthuis said on Sunday said the only objective for public finances should be to eliminate deficits.

Speaking in a radio interview on Europe 1, Arthuis said, "Stop thinking that three percent would consitute a sort of reference and objective for public deficits...The only good approach is to balance public finances."

Arthuis was referring to the level of public deficits as a percentage of gross domestic product above which fines would be imposed on countries under the terms of a stability pact for members of a planned single European currency, agreed on Friday.
"The priority in the whole of the national community and in Europe is to get back to balance and put public finances on a sound footing," Arthuis said.
